description: Read and change the person’s Terminal: the grid of live cards they keep, in folders, each read again whenever it’s opened. Actions: list (every folder and card, each card’s id, title, number now and its move; folder: just that one), show (ids, up to 6, or folder: the cards freshly read, each with its rows), make (a folder of live cards, first on Terminal, from a template: game {game: its universe id}; due-diligence {game}; compare {games: [universe ids]}; genre {genre: as Roblox writes it}; word {word}; studio {studio: its key from find}; breaking-out; new-and-growing; hidden-gems; ideas-to-build; roblox-now; or ids: a folder of those cards; or title alone: an empty folder), set (id or folder, set: how it’s shown: view, size, range, rank, filter, games, compare, measure; position: where it goes), refresh (ids; none: every card), rename (id or folder, and title), remove and restore (id or folder; a removed one comes back for a day), move (id or folder, and position: 1 = first), file (ids and folder) and unfile (ids). Opens with RoBot: an account RoBot isn’t open on yet gets not_available.

asked.description: rename a folder: true only when the person asked for this new name

fill.description: For make: what fills the template, like {game: "grow a garden"}, {games: [..]} or {genre: "Tycoon"}

id.description: A card’s id (12 characters, from list or show)

ids.description: Cards’ ids (show, refresh, make, file, unfile; for move, the order wanted)

position.description: For move and set: where it goes, 1 = first

set.description: For set: only what changes. view: list, chart, map, table, stat or own; size: small, medium, large, extra large, wide; range: 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, 1Y or All; rank: players, growth, new, robux or own; filter: all, rising, new or a genre; games: names or ids (["all"] for every one); compare: last period, last year or none; measure: robux, players, visits, daily, new or hours

name: track
title: Your Terminal
